P1.interpretation: The procedure detected fewer than half as bounded; it does not establish that fewer than half actually have bounded finite least ray bonds because 458 families remain unresolved. P1 as a claim about the underlying property is undecided, not falsified by treating missing classifications as nonbounded.

audit: raw and merged record reconciliation; no DP replay

bounded_tail_analysis.conditional_authority: Recurrence words derived from recorded rate metadata, conditional on correctness of the DP and repeat detection; no DP replay in this lane
bounded_tail_analysis.headline_caveat: 204 zero-gain labels include 10 with only early finite bonds and an all-INF tail. Only 194 recorded zero-gain cases have finite recurring bonds. Of those, 187 settle to a single size (17 at 2, 167 at 3, 3 at 4) and 7 vary periodically between 2 and 3. The 173/30/1 headline records observed minima, not settled limits.

classification.producer_summarize_caveat: On merged placeholders, all([]) would classify all 11 unfinished as no ray bond; states=None would also raise TypeError at states>STATE_CAP. On raw glob without deduplication it counts 831, not 664. Stored summary thus requires a custom merge/aggregation path absent from the supplied producer scripts; its numbers are independently reproducible with explicit unfinished handling.

independence.classification_and_comparators: Independent code in this script; no producer summarize, run_family or extrapolate calls
independence.shared_library_use: Cohort reconstruction only: depth_sequence and relations on usual definitions; no recorded L recomputation

limitations: No independent DP or SAT recomputation in this record-audit lane.
Shared dlang semantics are used only to reconstruct the 664 expected family indices.

Raw records contain elapsed worker timings but no start/finish timestamps or termination logs; the reported three-and-a-half-hour stop and chronological winner order cannot be verified from these files.
Coverage reconciliation proves accounting, not correctness of an L value or eventual classification.
Exactly matching scientific duplicate fields corroborates unchanged outputs but does not independently validate the shared producing implementation.
Tail classifications above are conditional deductions from recorded repeats, not new theorem evidence.

merge.ordering_note: Merged finished records equal first-by-idx in ascending filename order, equivalently last-by-idx in descending filename order. Chronological completion order is not recorded; no chronological last-write claim is made.

undetermined.rising_wording_caveat: 240 means only L(30)>L(1), not growth throughout the final ten levels: 26 of 240 are constant from s20 through s30. All 403 full-depth undetermined sequences are nondecreasing. The 55/71/29 counts correspond to endpoint increments 29/15/10, not certified eventual rates.
